article.story: ATLANTA -- — Jaden Jackson and Eric Parnell scored 15 points apiece — all on 3-pointers — and Georgia State cruised to a 78-53 victory over Norfolk State on Sunday. Jackson made 5 of 9 shots from long distance for the Panthers (2-3) and Parnell was a perfect 5 for 5 off the bench. Jacob Meyer and David Thomas both scored 13 for Georgia State, which took a 39-26 lead into halftime. Bahsil Laster scored 21 to lead the Spartans (2-3) on 8-for-14 shooting with three 3-pointers. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
